paragraphs: The day starts by disinfecting tools. When a regular client arrives, the barber asks about recent life before beginning. Three clients receive cuts in the morning, each with head-shape assessment, symmetrical clipper work, finishing, and care advice. In the afternoon, one client wants a style change and collaborates on a new outline. Later, the barber follows up with members and promotes services, then cleans the station, sharpens scissors, and prepares for the next day.
